title: 7BR Scottsdale Resort | Pool • Sport Court • Spa
description:
Seven bedrooms, free heated pool, full sport court, hot tub, and enough amenities to fill an entire weekend. Built for groups, sleeping up to 23 guests.

* Free Heated Pool & Hot Tub
* Full Sport Court: Pickleball, Basketball & Volleyball
* Kids' Suite with Climbing Wall & Arcade
* Fire Pit, BBQ & Outdoor Dining
* TVs in Every Bedroom

Minutes from the best of Scottsdale — but you may never want to leave!

review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Jeff and Bridget’s place was absolutely gorgeous! It was incredibly spacious and had plenty of room for our large group. The backyard was definitely a highlight—we loved having such a beautiful space to relax and enjoy together! Jeff and Bridget were wonderful hosts, very welcoming and easy to communicate with. We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend their home to anyone looking for a beautiful place to stay!
Absolutely enjoyed our stay! Jeff and Bridget were super helpful and a pleasure to communicate with. Our family really enjoyed the staycation!
Jeff and Bridget’s place was an awesome place for our family vacation. Great location. Jeff and Bridget were very responsive when we had questions. Would highly recommend.

This home had so many things for our children to do! Loved the pool and outdoor activities.  The back room  for the kids was perfect when it was hot outside, the kids had so much fun playing all the games and the rock wall.  We had friends come for dinner one night and the kitchen was perfect for all we needed and the large table for all of us.   The beds are comfortable , and the amount of space available for all the guests is great! Our kids would love to come back to this property some time!
